changes: Changed Ocean and Terrain Tesselation to be true, while WIP its good for us to have them default to on for testing purposes to highlight boot issues for lower end systems. May change in future.
Added Decal terrain modifier.
Ported Simplex Noise library over to C#. Needs some formatting cleanup, but it works.

Added PlanetMapPoiDisplay class for visualising the planet map and a point of interest. Currently only used for the decal modifier in the terrain editor, but might prove useful elsewhere in the future.
Added 4 more float parameters to Planet.glsl.
Added texture support for modifiers. There is a maximum of 16 textures per planet unless more are required.
Added procedural modifier implementation on the CPU for accurate height queries from the Celestial.
Fixed incorrect biplanar blend factor Y using blend factor X on the CPU for tiling heightmaps.
Renamed 'PopulateMaterials' function to 'SetupRenderData', as that's what it does and is now responsible for procedural modifier render data alongside the Astronomical's.

Moved procedural modifier ordering so that it is done before the modifiers are collapsed into the render data structs to avoid repeating the ordering whenever we want to process the modifiers on the CPU.
Removed instances of invalid Brutal.Maths references after rebasing onto latest main.
Reduced the deformity of Luna's tiling heightmap
Minor fix for multisampling on a pipeline that doesn't support it

Fixed edge case in AnomalyInPatch method not catering for negative start and end anomaly cross -Pi or Pi boundary. This was causing the hovering over patches that matched this edge case to not allow you to create a burn on them.
Fixed an edge case calculating burn time on patches between -Pi and 0. Yep, a hangover of the -Pi to Pi orbit refactor from a couple of weeks ago that I'm still weeding out.
Fixed - we don't need to show orbit on rocket any more on startup. Because they are all on by default in map view and filtered in other camera modes.

Fixed a bug I created on Friday, because it was Friday and I should not have been making this change. Essentially we have to iterate over the burns calculating the flightplans from start to finish, not backwards, otherwise we end up with the wrong patch orbit for burns and then bad things happen.
Fixed Earth Only and Earth and Luna xml files.
Optimized erosion terrain modifier. Moved from the original 64-tap gavoronoise implementation to 8 by just sampling the cell corners and trilinearly interpolating them. Results in an 8x speedup!
Fixed camera animations not working if both map and local views had the same camera mode.
Fixed Transfer Planner to handle no solution found.
Fixed Transfer Planner to handle same SOI transfer UI notifications correctly, was showing same SOI when there was no actual solution.
Fixed Transfer Planner to not allow planning to a body that has no SOI defined.
Fixed Transfer Planner to not allow planning to a body that is hyperbolic or Parabolic.

Fixed some of the orbit UI and line filtering. Specifically - when measuring patched conics orbits for Burns it was using the wrong orbit. Now it uses the largest orbit in the burn's flightplan to determine whether to display the UI and orbit lines or not.
Fixed display of hyperbolic orbits to use the Sphere of Influence of the parent to measure the distance on whether to display the UI and orbit lines or not.
Missed file from last commit
Fixed some of the UI business for celestials by only showing names and other details depending on how far from the camera they are and whether the player is hovering the cursor over them or not.
Changed it so when you hover over patch events (capture, escape, etc) that it recognises this and only draws one set of UI information. Rather than multiple olverlapping information UIs.
Added ability to toggle orbit lines and UIs for the groups: Planets, Comets and Moons to the main menu.
Added ability to create and manipulate burns for any vehicle regardless of what astronomical object the camera might be following.
Fixed burndebug debuig info UI window after the gizmos were upgraded.
Further cleaned up the C# procedural noise library
Added a new map camera alongside the free and orbit cameras.
Changed the grid rendering to have dynamic major and minor axes and smoothly grow or shrink axes to the next or previous 'level'.
Fixed a few divide by zeros caused by camera rotations being exactly along a world axis.
Fixed hovering on visible and invisible orbit lines in orbital camera mode showing tooltips.
Changed Pe and Ap markers to only show additional info tooltip when hovering near them.
Fixed calculation of next event to handle Ap and Pe correctly for Hyperbolic orbits.
Fixed calculation of next event to actually return the correct game time - not event time.
Fixed a few minor details on the warp to next event button so you can't activate it when it's already running or the next event is imminent.
Fixed hovering over markers on orbits stopping nearest point to mouse not being highlighted.
Fixed next even showing SOI event when it's in fact an impact.
Added follow functionality to the map view.
Fixed a bug with loading that would invert 'map' logic for orbit lines. Definitely need to do serialization per viewport rather than relying on the camera but this works for now.
Add ability to toggle flight plan UI on and off for any vehicle via the View dropdown menu.
Fixed current following vehicle patches being drawn regardless of the showorbit flag.
Fixed orbit line settings getting out of sync when you load a file.
Renamed Situation.Burning back to Situation.Maneuvering which was caught up in a rename sweep.
Minor text tweaks.
Removed a bunch of duplicate or unneeded using statements
Changed IsApprox() to also be usable on types of doubles rather than only statically.
Added scroll wheel support to the map.
Menu-bar interaction fix. This also caused issues with secondary windows occasionally not being detachable from the main window
Fixed celestial names being eaten when moving the camera quickly.
Added mouse dragging to the map view.
Changed the orbit line and UI filtering to filter things out that are further away from the camera.
Fixed an issue where it was measuring both the patch orbit and the parent body orbit to determine whether to draw patch orbits. It should only measure the patch orbit in this case.
Removed Orbit from Vehicle. The current orbit is now always the first patch in the flight plan.
Deleted IParent. Moved this functionality to IOrbiting.
Fixed computation of orbital elements in the set orbit debug UI.
Fixed Mars atmosphere physical scale height.
